Cached under the `products` key, so `useNuxtData('products')` reads them too. */ export function useProducts() { return useFetch('/api/products', { key: 'products', default: () => [] }) } /** `10` -> `10%`. */ export function formatPercent(percent: number): string { return `${percent}%` } /** `percent` of `cents`, rounded to the nearest cent. */ export function percentOf(cents: number, percent: number): number { return Math.round(cents * percent / 100) } export interface Product { slug: string name: string priceCents: number } import { formatMoney } from '~/utils/money' /** * Price after discount, as shown in the UI. * The discount is rounded down, so the UI never promises more than the server quote. */ export function applyDiscount(cents: number, percent: number): number { return cents - Math.floor(cents * percent / 100) } /** `399` -> `-$3.99`. */ export function formatDiscount(cents: number): string { return `-${formatMoney(cents)}` }
